title: Reinstated Hold Base Length by Fee Payment Method — Homesite Reservation
content:
The reinstated base length of a reinstated Homesite Reservation hold is set by how the latest payment received with the component reinstatement fee on the reservation ledger was paid.

| Payment method of the latest reinstatement fee payment | Reinstated base length |
|---|---|
| ACH | 10 days |
| wire | 10 days |
| certified funds | 10 days |
| card | 8 days |
| any other case (for example a personal check) | the class's extension days |

## Reading the ledger

Only the latest payment booked with the component reinstatement fee is read; payments booked to the reservation deposit, the premium holding fee or any other fee do not decide the base length. Where more than one reinstatement fee payment stands on the ledger, the one with the latest posting date decides.

## Illustration (hypothetical class extension days of 5)

| Latest reinstatement fee payment | Base length |
|---|---|
| paid by wire | 10 days |
| paid by card | 8 days |
| paid by check | 5 days |
